title: Concept: Process-wide TLS verification off via process.env.NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = "0"; (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, process.env.NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = "0"; disables certificate verification for every outbound TLS connection in the process. Any on-path attacker can then present a self-signed certificate and read or modify the traffic, including credentials and tokens. Remove the override and trust the issuing CA (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS with the private CA).
applicability: javascript processes that make outbound TLS connections; lexical scope.
risk: Credential and data interception; HIGH severity.
